R449.note: Adds per-category method whitelist so dynamic dispatch can only reach the documented email.send action; unrelated behaviour unchanged.

R450.note: Standard Laravel can: middleware + ownership Policy runs before the controller; matches the stated contract (same success shape, 403 for others, refund() not called first).

R451.note: Traversal and extension are correctly closed, but the fix silently replaces the admin's chosen filename with a random GUID (disclosed in the write-up) rather than sanitizing/preserving it, discarding the original naming intent.

R452.note: Adds the missing secure:true flag only; no other observable change.

R453.note: Replaces Markup() with html.escape() for the interpolated label; correctly neutralizes the injection with no other behaviour change.

R454.note: Pins ValidAlgorithms to HmacSha256 matching the symmetric key in use, closing the algorithm-confusion gap without altering other validation.

R455.note: Adds a straightforward bounds check before the array read; valid indices 0-15 behave exactly as before.

R456.note: subtle.ConstantTimeCompare enforces exact-length, exact-content match and correctly returns false on any mismatch, matching the stated contract.

R457.note: Only rejects URIs with a non-null scheme; misses the classic scheme-relative bypass (e.g. //evil.com/path), which java.net.URI parses with a null scheme and host set, so the check does not close open redirect fully.

R458.note: Replacing shell exec with archive/tar correctly eliminates command injection, but the new ListArchive never uses the ctx parameter, silently dropping the request-context cancellation the stated contract requires.

R459.note: weak_ptr/shared_ptr with lock() is the standard idiom for this UAF; all call sites in the case are updated consistently and publish() still calls onEvent on live subscribers in order.

R460.note: Quoting plus backslash/quote escaping does not literally escape raw CR/LF as the docstring claims, but since a user-supplied quote can never appear unescaped, any embedded newline still produces an unbalanced-quote line that Redis rejects, blocking the demonstrated command-splicing attack.

R461.note: Swaps in SecureRandom and discards the attacker-controlled seed; no other behaviour change.
